# Volunteer museum

The museum opens on Saturdays, 11:00–16:00. Twelve volunteers cover two shifts. Four volunteers have no smartphone. The annual printing allowance is £120; £90 remains. The coordinator wants fewer missed shifts without excluding anyone. The existing paper rota works offline. A draft online rota has no offline mode and costs £8 a month. No migration, purchase or public announcement is approved.

A separate archive project has 300 scanned postcards. Volunteers may label copies; originals must remain unchanged. The archive's audience and retention period have not been agreed. The museum's staff count is not in the project files.
